about: Step onto golf’s biggest stages and prove you can rise among the greats. Compete in the ultimate test: The PGA Championship, The U.S. Open, and The Open Championship make their PGA TOUR 2K debut.

Rise through the ranks in an expanded MyCAREER, where every round builds your legacy. Create your path to greatness with new MyPLAYER customization, upgraded Skill Trees, and advanced Course Designer tools.
Then take your shot against the best in ranked, casual, and cross-platform multiplayer.
You didn’t show up for second place.
Team up or face off in Match Play, Scramble, or Skins - online or local. Compete in cross-platform societies, earn seasonal rewards, and rise through daily and weekly tournaments.
